name: Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land Kirby Mini-Game
summary: Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land Kirby Mini-Game is a web game in the Kirby series. It was developed and published by Nintendo in 2003 as a promotion for Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land. It was a downloadable reward only accessible to members of Nintendo VIP 24:7 (a Europe-exclusive loyalty program that was later rebranded as Club Nintendo) who registered their copy of the game on the Nintendo VIP 24:7 website.
